title: Classic British Herb Wrap
description: A simple yet flavorful wrap filled with fresh herbs and rose-petal relish.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together the rose-petal relish, parsley, mint, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
3. Lay the British wrap flat and spread the herb mixture evenly across the center of the wrap.
4. Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
5. Place the wrap seam-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake the wrap in the preheated oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
7. Remove the wrap from the oven and let cool for 1-2 minutes before slicing and serving.
